author: TotallyTotle
body:
So pretty much I ran up to him today and he was with his bow shooting at someone else and when I went close to him he rapidly started hitting me with his bow, I tried it twice. Then I started hitting him rapidly and he started bobbing up and down whilst hitting me. The way I know that was hacks is normally when your PVPing you don't bob up and down nothing happends but with Kill Aura on you bob up down whilst PVPing. Then after he killed me I asked him to do .help and he just replied with "I dont hack I've got a gaming mouse" and he completely avoided my question of doing .help with words like I dont hack and I have a gaming mouse. Heres the proof.

Look at my name and Androuw and he just blabs on about him not hacking and his gaming mouse
